Top half: dual panes — left shows Zeta project root with file-type icons and git status badges (M), right shows tests/ directory. Bottom half split: Editor pane (left) showing README.md with ASCII art Zeta logo being edited; Markdown Preview pane (right) showing live rendered output. Status bar: git branch (main), up:14ms scan:0ms d:3515. Themes menu item visible in menu bar. Function key row: Ctrl+S Save, Ctrl+F Find, F3 Next, Esc Close.
